text:
alice: Heads-up — planning a dual-write + backfill for user_profiles schema change. Proposing Tue 22:00 UTC (maintenance window 22:00–01:00). Who can own deploy + smoke?
ben: I can take the deploy steps. Want me to run the schema migration and enable dual-write?
alice: yes please. Migration is add `preferred_name` (nullable) + index on last_active. Backfill expected ~30m - 2h depending on replicas.
carol: Quick q — is the new index `CONCURRENTLY` safe for our load? We should avoid long locks.
eve: We'll use `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` in the migration job. Backfill script will batch by id ranges, rate-limited. I'll own the backfill run.
dave: Oncall/SRE here — Tue 22:00 UTC works for us but we need a smoke checklist and rollback plan. Can you paste the runbook steps?
alice: runbook draft below:
```
- prewindow: run `pg_stat_activity` diff, snapshot replicas lag
- deploy: apply schema change (no lock ops), enable app dual-write flag
- smoke: run 10 representative reads/writes + reconciliation job check
- backfill: start batched backfill, monitor replica lag < 5s
- cutover: once backfill coverage > 99% and smoke green, flip feature flag
- rollback: disable dual-write, revert feature flag, run compensating backfill if needed
```
ben: Will push the migration job and feature flag changes. Can add a `--dry-run` step for precheck.
eve: Backfill script params I plan to run:
```
python backfill.py --table user_profiles --batch-size 1000 --sleep-ms 200
```
carol: QA — I can run the smoke queries and basic reconciliation after you enable dual-write. Which queries should I run?
dave: Make sure these checks are in the smoke job:
- new column exists on primary and replica
- sample 100 rows from recent 24h to ensure dual-write parity
- index health: `pg_stat_progress_create_index` absence of blocking
- replication lag monitor alert suppressor (we'll temporarily allow 10s)

alice: adding those to the checklist. Also tagging owners:
- deploy owner: ben
- backfill owner: eve
- smoke owner: carol
- rollback lead: alice
- SRE observer: dave

deploy-bot: Slot reserved for 2024-06-11T22:00:00Z by ben (slot-id: s-8421) :white_check_mark:
ben: pinging infra to ensure we have warm replicas and slow_query logging enabled.
eve: ETA for backfill windows: initial estimate 45–90m. I'll post progress updates every 15m.
dave: If replica lag > 30s or error rate upticks +50% we abort and rollback. Keep logs accessible (share S3 link).
carol: I'll prepare a short smoke script: 10 writes -> reconcile -> loop. Post here when ready so I can run pre-window.
alice: Thanks. If no objections, lock window. :thumbsup:
ben: :thumbsup: locking. I'll create the PR for migration and feature flag toggle now and cc owners.
eve: I'll test backfill in staging tomorrow and paste the command + sample output here.
dave: SRE will standby Tue 21:30 UTC for prechecks.
alice: Great — final reminder: keep migration idempotent and include a toggled metric so we can measure mismatch rate.
carol: noted. I'll add a post-migration quick-check in the health dashboard.
alice: OK closing the loop — see you in the channel during the window. Post any blockers ASAP.
